items.title: Mrs. Arnold Metoyer Interview, 1960-10-19
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Or he went to school, or anything to learn with Carnet?

ctx.x: Or he went to school, or anything to learn with Carnet?
Well, no. He took it up with a relation of him by the name of Oscar Giovanni. Oscar Giovanni. Mm-hmm. But he never had no regular teacher. He just picked it up himself.
